acquirer.value: Kayne Anderson Energy Infrastructure Fund, Inc.
acquirer.span: The Meeting is being held to approve the combination of FMO and Kayne Anderson Energy Infrastructure Fund, Inc. (“KYN”) by means of a tax-free merger, pursuant to which FMO will be merged with and into KYN

targets.span: This joint proxy statement/prospectus is being sent to you by the Board of Trustees (the “Board”) of Fiduciary/Claymore Energy Infrastructure Fund (“FMO”), a Delaware statutory trust.

n_targets.span: a proposal authorizing the combination of FMO and KYN, which will be accomplished as a tax-free merger of FMO into KYN (the “Merger”)

exchange_basis.span: The aggregate NAV of KYN common stock received by FMO common shareholders in the Merger will equal the aggregate NAV of FMO shares held on the business day prior to closing of the Merger (excluding cash distributed by KYN for fractional shares).

spans: The Merger is subject to a vote by FMO’s shareholders. If shareholders do not approve the Merger, then the Merger will not take place.

expected_close.value: during the first quarter of fiscal 2022
expected_close.span: The Merger is expected to take effect as soon as practicable once the shareholder vote and other customary conditions to closing are satisfied, which is expected to occur during the first quarter of fiscal 2022.

record_date.span: The Board has fixed the close of business on October 29, 2021, as the record date for the determination of shareholders entitled to notice of, and to vote at, the Meeting

notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2021-10-22) for the merger of FMO into KYN; the excerpt ends inside the Risk Factors section, so the Merger Agreement terms (Appendix A, 'Terms of the Agreement and Plan of Merger') are not in front of me. exchange_ratio null: the ratio is set on relative NAVs on the business day before closing; the ~1.32 KYN shares per FMO share is stated only as illustrative (NAVs as of 2021-09-30). cash_per_share null: cash only in lieu of fractional shares. collar null: not stated. meeting_date null: the meeting date is left blank ('____, 2022'). conditions: the excerpt states the shareholder vote and 'other customary conditions to closing' without naming them, so only shareholder_approval is listed. n_targets is a count of the one target named (FMO), not a stated number. termination_date not stated in the excerpt. Combination would issue approximately 9.4 million KYN shares (about 7% of KYN outstanding) per the filing; KYN holders do not vote.
